svg.font-family: Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif
svg.title: Order service in a VPC
svg.desc: 1. user → alb: HTTPS; 2. alb → api: /orders; 3. api → cache: check stock; 4. cache → api: hit; 5. api → db: INSERT; 6. db → api: OK; 7. api → q: order.created; 8. q → worker: consume; 9. worker → mail: confirmation email; 10. api → user: 201
